plugin.name: 🎯 Session
plugin.description: Add, edit, and remove timeblocks in NotePlan, or timeblock an item and start Session.
plugin.author: Nomas Prime
plugin.lastUpdateInfo: Use /timeblock to add or edit a timeblock and /untimeblock to remove its time range.

plugin.commands.name: start
plugin.commands.description: Timeblock the selected item or add a child session, then start Session.

plugin.commands.name: timeblock
plugin.commands.description: Add or edit the time range on the selected item.

plugin.commands.name: untimeblock
plugin.commands.description: Remove the time range from the selected timeblock and keep the item.

plugin.settings.title: Unestimated Session Duration
plugin.settings.description: Duration of child sessions when the selected item is unestimated

plugin.settings.title: Unestimated Session Title
plugin.settings.description: Title of child sessions when the selected item is unestimated
